row.team_price_text: Account-Based Advertising: Contact Sales (Request a Demo)
row.evidence: AdRoll ABM's help centre says "Single Sign-On (SSO) integration is included with all paid packages" and documents SCIM v2 at https://app.adroll.com/api/v1/scim, but every ABM package on the pricing page is "Request a Demo".
row.notes: Quote-only: RollWorks is now AdRoll ABM (rollworks.com redirects to adroll.com/solutions/account-based-marketing). The ABM packages (Account-Based Advertising, Account-Based Marketing + Advertising, Account-Based Marketing) have no public prices, so status is gated under rule 6a although the help centre says SAML SSO and SCIM are included in every paid package with no add-on fee (Free Tier excluded). Account-Based Retargeting ('No fee to get started and pay only for media') is not in the SSO package table. SCIM 2.0 needs SAML first and onboarding through the Customer Success Manager; bearer token is an admin Personal Access Token; supports userName, name, active and a NextRoll extension for role (user/admin), advertiser-profile access and billing permission; IdP removal deactivates the user. One IdP at a time; no JIT. Seats are unlimited. Okta's catalogue 'AdRoll' app is SWA-only (2014) and Entra setup uses a non-gallery app, so both are via_generic.

plans.name: Account-Based Retargeting
plans.price_text: No fee to get started; pay only for media
plans.notes: Not listed in the help centre's SSO package table.

auth.token_source: Personal Access Token generated from the settings page by an AdRoll organization administrator

endpoints.notes: Endpoint paths are not listed; Users is inferred from the documented user create/update/deactivate behaviour and user attributes. No group attributes are documented.

operations.notes: Docs say accounts can be updated (email, name, permissions) but do not say whether PUT or PATCH is used; 'remove' from the IdP deactivates the AdRoll ABM user. Some IdPs reactivate a previous account when an email is reused.

deprovision.notes: Seats are unlimited on every package, so seat freeing is moot (c26).

custom.how: NextRoll extension urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:nextroll:User with organizationRole (user|admin), advertisableEIDs (comma-separated advertisable EIDs, required for the user role) and billingAllowed (boolean); any other attribute is ignored

roles.how: organizationRole extension attribute (user or admin), plus advertisableEIDs and billingAllowed for per-profile access and billing permission

limitations.text: SAML must be configured before SCIM, and setup requires sending the SAML metadata.xml to AdRoll's Customer Success Manager.
Only one identity provider can be configured at a time.
Some IdPs deactivate the account and create a new one when a user's email (userName) changes.
Attributes outside the documented list are ignored; permissions need the NextRoll custom schema extension.

scim.notes: SCIM is documented as part of the SSO integration included in every paid ABM package (Account-Based Advertising, Account-Based Marketing + Advertising, Account-Based Marketing, and legacy Starter/Standard/Professional/Ultimate). The same SSO/SCIM article exists on help.adroll.com for core AdRoll.

user_api.notes: AdRoll's developer portal (developers.nextroll.com) is a JS app that the headless renderer could not load (ERR_TOO_MANY_RETRIES), so a user-management endpoint could not be confirmed. The pricing page lists 'Reporting APIs' for core AdRoll.

okta.notes: OIN 'AdRoll' app (last updated Mar 2014) marks only SWA (read from page markup); no RollWorks/AdRoll ABM app (okta.com/integrations/rollworks/ is 404). AdRoll's SSO guide names Okta as an example IdP for its generic SAML + SCIM setup.

entra.notes: No gallery app (rollworks-tutorial and adroll-tutorial are 404); the vendor's Entra guide uses a non-gallery enterprise app with SAML and SCIM.

fallbacks.notes: Without SCIM, accounts are created manually in the dashboard (Settings > Company > User Permissions).
